candidate_lock.scope: Experimental metadata-validated flat/nested HFA entry/call/result packing and value-type field addressing. The class-macro recognizer additionally preserves scheduled scalar FP loads; the bounded class-load witness also admits independent unsigned-offset 32-bit loads and rejects flag/finished W0 clobbers. see native-fp-class-guard-caller and recovered-fp-class-guard reports. Closed-generic layouts and nested scalar FP field paths preserve observed base-field offsets and tail-padding reuse; unsupported layouts stay diagnostic. Analysis-warning tails terminate by throwing so even unreachable tails cannot fall off a CIL method. Surviving parameters bind to original signature positions even when earlier arguments are unused. Type literal operands keep RuntimeTypeHandle when required by the exact expected parameter type, instead of materializing System.Type before the native managed call. Adjacent reference-type constructor fusion recognizes equivalent closed generic owner contexts by canonical metadata definition/arguments, preserving receiver/block/order guards. Existing public nonvirtual scalar/ref accessors restore foreign private field access only after exact native leaf proof. Exact complete two-word field-copy leaves recover managed whole-value assignment/return before generic ABI analysis. Reviewed returning exception factories preserve their exact default constructor effect. Exact value-this adjustors select independently bounded unboxed bodies and unique aliases while registered addresses stay intact. Reviewed primitive boxing retains only proven initialized typed storage; address-taken and array liveness preserve original stores. Exact FDE-bounded CFG witnesses recover cached metadata flags and cold initialization paths while preserving scheduled arithmetic; the additive ordinary-method route requires an exact zR frame with empty FDE augmentation and retains the unchanged bounded matcher. Unknown/exception-bearing frames are excluded from that new route; the pre-existing selected route still includes twelve zPLR bodies with unverified exception semantics. typed legacy class initialization lowers to the existing CLR class-constructor contract rather than a no-op. Reviewed raw class-init ABI captures require an unused result and exact metadata origin; known runtime helpers cannot acquire stale managed MethodInfo identities. Class metadata Phi inputs require exact original type identity and edge-end definition availability, with topology, escape, cycle, 32-local and 256-visit bounds; constructor and reload order stay intact. A pinned native caller/callee/constructor descriptor binds one reviewed indirect Enumerator return to its original stack buffer before SSA; broader generic structure sizing and exception cleanup remain unresolved. Native virtual dispatch carries an explicit receiver/target/slot proof through IR and emission; unsupported native virtual candidates remain indirect, while original direct/base calls retain their dispatch. This narrow reference-receiver, parameterless integer/reference-return witness does not recover general ABI widths, generic/interface/value-type dispatch or EH. Canonical patch stays separate. Stack-spilled HFAs are explicit recovery failures; integer multiword aggregates and general generic/indirect call recovery remain outside this experiment. No clean-source or whole-ABI claim.

diagnostic_delta.methodology: Each complete matching-reference log is streamed. Canonical lines remove build-worker prefixes, surrounding whitespace and duplicate build-summary occurrences, and must exactly match the authoritative summary total and error-code counts. Multisets of relative source path, code and message additionally reduce line-shift inflation; local-name or decompiler presentation changes can still alter messages. Every diagnostic-bearing file is checked against the byte-identical export/matching-reference source manifest. Reports contain no source excerpts.
diagnostic_delta.limits: Diagnostic lines include compiler cascades and are not independent bugs, recovered-method counts or completion percentages. This read-only comparison neither executes recovered game methods nor establishes that added or removed diagnostics correspond to correct semantics. Complete source compilation, original-runtime/gameplay parity and portability remain separate requirements.
